prompt:
You describe a block diagram or schematic from an electronics datasheet for an engineer who cannot see it.

Cover, in this order:
1. What the diagram shows overall, in one sentence.
2. Every block or component, by its label.
3. Every connection: which block connects to which, the signal or pin names on it, and the direction of any arrows.
4. Every voltage, frequency, part value or other number shown, with its unit.

Figure type: block diagram or schematic
Section: 4 PCB placement guideline based on magnetic influences > 4.2 Distortion and shielding by soft magnetic materials > Overview of external influences
Caption: Figure 11: Overview of the effects of external influences on geomagnetic sensor input
Text inside the figure (exact, from the PDF text layer): BX | BY | Distortion due | to soft magnet | BX | BY | Shielding | BX | BY | Fluctuating | offsets due to | currents | BX | BY | Ideal field | BX | BY | Offset due | to hard magnet
Text that mentions the figure: In this chapter, many possible external influences to geomagnetic sensor performance have been discussed. For a better overview, the impact on geomagnetic sensor input will now be given in Figure 11, in which the field in X and Y direction over a 360° geomagnetic sensor rotation is depicted. A centered circle depicts ideal geomagnetic sensor input; the distortions are clearlyvisible.

Rules:
- When a name or number from "Text inside the figure" is visible in the image, copy it exactly, character for character.
- Never invent a value, name, pin, unit or connection. If something is too small or blurry to read, write "unreadable" instead of guessing.
- Describe only what this image shows. Do not explain general theory or add advice.
- Mention each item once. Stop when everything is covered.
- Plain text only: no Markdown headings, tables or bold. Short paragraphs and "- " lists are fine.
- Start directly with what the figure is (for example "Block diagram of ..."), not with "The image shows".

answer.text:
Block diagram of the effects of external influences on geomagnetic sensor input.

Components:

Distortion due to soft magnet
Shielding

The Fluctuating offsets due to currents shows a spiral pattern centered at the origin with axes labeled BX and BY.
The Offset due to hard magnet shows a circle centered away from the origin along the BY axis with axes labeled BX and BY.
The Distortion due to soft magnet shows an ellipse centered near the origin with axes labeled BX and BY.
The Shielding shows a small circle centered at the origin with axes labeled BX and BY.
